plugins.description: Take real, published self-assessments (Big Five, personal values, character strengths, and more) and get honest, strength-focused explanations of what your results mean. Not therapy, diagnosis, or treatment; if you want a real counselor, Psychology can suggest one to look into, but you always do your own checking before reaching out.
